title: A Measurement Study of LLM Inference Trade-offs Across Edge Continuum Hardware
abstract: arXiv:2609.08307v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as backends for intelligent web services, but serving them across the edge continuum requires balancing quality, latency, model footprint, and energy. This paper presents a controlled measurement study of self-hosted LLM inference across edge and near-edge deployment nodes: an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin and a near-edge server with CPU-only and GPU-enabled inference modes. We evaluate multiple open-weight LLMs and quantization variants using a fixed question-answering workload, and compare them against GPT-4o as a cloud-hosted accuracy and latency reference. Our benchmarking pipeline reports accuracy, model footprint, per-token decoding latency, prefill latency, and overall execution energy. The results show that GPU-enabled server execution provides the lowest compute-side latency, while Jetson Orin shows lower measured energy, consistent with its lower platform power under our setup. translated_title: 边缘连续体硬件上大语言模型推理权衡的测量研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作智能网络服务的后端，但在边缘连续体上部署它们需要在质量、延迟、模型占用空间和能耗之间进行权衡。本文对自托管的大语言模型推理在边缘和近边缘部署节点上进行了受控测量研究，节点包括一台NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin以及一台支持纯CPU和GPU推理模式的近边缘服务器。我们使用固定的问答工作负载评估了多个开源权重的大语言模型及其量化变体，并将云端托管的GPT-4o作为准确性和延迟的参考基准。我们的基准测试流程报告了准确性、模型占用空间、每token解码延迟、预填充延迟和整体执行能耗。结果表明，启用GPU的服务器执行提供了最低的计算端延迟，而Jetson Orin显示出更低的实测能耗，这与其在实验设置下较低的平台功耗相一致。
tldr: 本文通过对边缘与近边缘硬件上多种开源大语言模型推理的受控测量研究，发现GPU服务器提供最低延迟而Jetson Orin能耗更低，为大语言模型边缘部署中的质量、延迟与能耗权衡提供了实证依据。
en_tdlr: This controlled measurement study of LLM inference across edge continuum hardware finds that GPU-enabled servers deliver the lowest latency while Jetson Orin consumes less energy, providing empirical insights into the quality-latency-energy trade-offs of edge LLM deployment.
